publications.title: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent, Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould Highlight Community Bank Comeback at Arizona Bankers Association Roundtable
publications.summary: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent and Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan V. Gould today highlighted the Trump Administration's efforts to alleviate regulatory burden on community banks, drive economic growth on Main Street, and protect America's financial system from illicit activity during remarks at the Arizona Bankers Association Roundtable.

publications.title: Artificial Intelligence Consortium minutes – June 2026
publications.summary: The Artificial Intelligence Consortium (AIC) aims to provide a platform for public-private engagement to further dialogue on the capabilities, development, deployment, use, and potential risks of artificial intelligence (AI) in UK financial services.
